_notes: access_method values: manual_upload | email_notification | rss | public_page | api.
public_page sources are never fetched automatically until allowed_fetch is true AND you have read the site's terms of use.
url_verified false means the URL was written from general knowledge and must be confirmed in a browser before relying on it.

sources.name: eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA)
sources.notes: Statewide portal used by state agencies, University System of Maryland and many counties. Public solicitation browsing without login; free vendor registration enables email notifications by commodity code. No documented public API.

sources.name: eMMA email notifications
sources.notes: Register as a vendor, subscribe to commodity codes for the four industries, then set IMAP_* in .env so the scanner can read the notification emails you receive.

sources.name: Montgomery County Office of Procurement
sources.notes: Has a Local Small Business Reserve (LSBR) program.

sources.name: Prince George's County Office of Central Services
sources.notes: County-based business preference programs may apply.

sources.name: Baltimore City Public Schools Procurement
sources.notes: Food service, custodial and facilities contracts.

University System of Maryland institutions
sources.notes: UMD, UMB, UMBC, Towson and others post on eMMA; some also maintain their own procurement pages.

sources.name: University of Maryland Medical System supplier portal
sources.notes: Private non-profit system with public ties; supplier registration rather than public bids. Confirm process before relying on it.

sources.name: Maryland Department of General Services
sources.notes: Facilities maintenance and small construction for state buildings; solicitations appear on eMMA.
